articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - New Era Energy Digital, Inc. (Nasdaq: NUAI) (“New Era” or the “Company”), a developer of next-generation digital infrastructure and integrated power assets, today announced the appointments of Evan Pierce as Chief Development Officer and Michael Johnson as General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer, effective June 1, 2026. The appointments further strengthen New Era’s execution capabilities as the Company continues building a leadership team with directly relevant experience across hyperscale data centers, power development, site acquisition, construction, leasing and project finance. Mr. Pierce brings more than 20 years of leadership experience spanning hyperscale data centers, energy infrastructure, grid strategy and mission-critical operations across the Americas and EMEA.
